criteria.requirement: Add TTLCache.remaining(key,*,time=None), returning expires-now using explicit time or one timer sample. Preserve timer arithmetic types including datetime/timedelta. Missing and expired/equal-boundary keys raise KeyError, with no physical expiry removal, value loading or LRU reordering. Do not extend expiry or alter __getitem__, ttl, pickle or capacity semantics; verify reads do not protect cold entries from eviction.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
